phase_tasks.task: Write Red tests proving settings/video/campaign API routes reject unauthenticated users
phase_tasks.verification: 5 phase-w3-*.test.ts files committed at 81d104e2 (Red). At that commit the routes were unguarded (guards added later at 4a6bb1d8), so the 401 assertions genuinely failed (true Red). All now green at HEAD.

phase_tasks.task: Add auth/role guards and tenant/global policy documentation for marketing routes
phase_tasks.verification: requireMarketingSession() (delegating to real requireAuth from @reading-advantage/auth) is the first statement in all 8 guarded route handlers and returns 401 before any DB/AI side effect. Global-internal (non-schoolId) policy documented in lib/auth.ts JSDoc + every route's JSDoc; asserted structurally by phase-w3-campaigns-auth.test.ts ('global-internal', 'authenticated staff', 'not scoped by schoolId').

phase_tasks.task: Write Red tests for Zod validation on settings, campaigns, topics, and script generation inputs
phase_tasks.verification: phase-w3-input-validation.test.ts (14 tests) committed at 81d104e2. Covers schema-level rejection + route-level 400 with side-effect absence for settings POST, campaigns POST/PATCH, save-topics, research-topics, generate-script. Critical generate-script test asserts a prompt-injection payload (topic as object) is rejected with 400 BEFORE buildScriptGenerationPrompt and createAIClient are reached, and a 60KB oversized topic is rejected.

phase_tasks.task: Route AI calls through shared AI adapter
phase_tasks.verification: generate-script/research-topics import createAIClient from @/lib/ai (re-export of @reading-advantage/ai); test-connection imports from @reading-advantage/ai directly. Static guard (phase-w3-ai-adapter.test.ts) scans all app/api/*.ts for @ai-sdk/*, @google/generative-ai, openai, @anthropic-ai/sdk imports and asserts count === 0 via a labeled integer ('Direct SDK import count: 0'). Behavioral tests confirm createAIClient is invoked with the stored API key.

phase_tasks.task: Prevent API key/token leakage in any unauthenticated response
phase_tasks.verification: GET /api/settings masks secret-shaped keys (apiKey/secret/token) as '••••' and never imports decrypt(), so plaintext never enters any response. AI route error handlers call redactSecrets() to scrub the API key from thrown error messages. Tests assert the exact seeded secret literal (plaintext AND ciphertext) does not appear in the unauthenticated 401 body (A7-compliant exact-literal match), and that decrypt/db.select/createAIClient are not invoked on the 401 path (A4-compliant side-effect proof).

Acceptance re-ran all gates at HEAD 3d123fc6: test 202/202, lint 0 errors, check-types 0 errors, build exit 0. Build was nominally deferred to marketing_golive Phase 0 per the phase plan but is in fact green at acceptance, so the task text 'tests/build/lint/type' is fully truthful (no A5).

A1_substring_as_signal.details: Orchestrator-internal (supervisor regex). Not exercised by Phase 2 product tests. No supervisor edits made in this product track.

A3_digit_only_count.details: phase-w3-ai-adapter.test.ts emits a labeled integer 'Direct SDK import count: N' (console.log) and asserts expect(directSdkImportCount).toBe(0). Not a bare rg/[0-9]+ match. Compliant.

A4_vacuous_pass.details: Every 401 test (groups 2A/2B/2C) has a paired authenticated positive control asserting status 200 AND validateSession called with the known token. A blanket-401 regression would fail the positive controls. Side-effect absence (decrypt/db.*/createAIClient not called) is asserted on every 401 path, so a route that 401s AFTER leaking still fails. The campaigns policy test asserts presence of the documented policy text, not a non-existent schoolId column. No vacuous-pass.

A5_false_claim_text.details: rg of plan.md for 'PASS=N...FAIL=0' / 'all checks pass' / 'all tests pass' returns no hits in Phase 2 task text. Plan task 6 'Run marketing targeted tests/build/lint/type' is marked [x]; acceptance verified build is green (exit 0) in addition to test/lint/check-types, so the 'build' wording is truthful. No false-claim text.

A6_registry_overstatement.details: measure/tracks.md does NOT claim the Wave 3 marketing security vulnerabilities (decrypted-API-key leak, unauthenticated /api/video/*) are 'resolved'. The only 'resolved' hit near marketing is the vinext/vite build blocker (tracks.md line 80), owned by marketing_golive. Acceptance ran `pnpm --filter marketing build` and it exits 0 ('Build complete'), so that build-'resolved' claim matches reality. All cited Phase 2 adversarial tests (phase-w3-*) are green. No overstatement.

A7_over_broad_filter.details: Body-leak scans match the exact seeded secret literals ('sk-w3-settings-secret-12345' plaintext AND its encrypt() ciphertext), not bare English words like 'secret'/'token'. Compliant.

A8_marker_ambiguity.details: Plan-marker hygiene handled by plan-update role. Phase 2 tasks use [~]/[x] only; no [ ] (space) markers introduced.

A9_archived_track_paths.details: New phase-w3-*.test.ts files reference measure/tracks/wave3_product_alignment_20260628/... only in docblock provenance comments; no runtime dependency on a track path. Tests exercise apps/marketing source. Path-independent.

A10_generated_facts_drift.details: N/A to marketing product tests (no measure/generated/ regeneration in scope).

A11_review_execution_blocked.details: Review track truthfulness class; Phase 2 is an implementation phase, not a review-execution track. N/A.

red_to_green_proof.red_nature: At 81d104e2 the 5 phase-w3-*.test.ts files were added but the marketing routes had NO requireMarketingSession guards and NO Zod schemas (guards/schemas added at 4a6bb1d8). Therefore the 401/validation assertions genuinely failed at the Red commit — a true Red, not an import-error or unrelated crash.

red_to_green_proof.verification: Acceptance confirmed guards present in all routes at HEAD and the full suite green (202/202).

nonblocking_findings.title: Intermittent mock-isolation flakiness on 2 tests
nonblocking_findings.description: Review-C reports phase-1-boot-adversarial (db.execute mock timeout) and phase-w3-video-auth research-topics positive control (AI client mock not applied to @/lib/ai re-export) pass on ~50% of runs. Acceptance's single full-suite run got 202/202 (both passed). vitest.config.ts already sets fileParallelism:false to mitigate; residual flakiness is a test-infrastructure issue, not a security-contract regression.
nonblocking_findings.recommendation: Track in a Wave 6 test-backfill task; consider a shared dbMock singleton (already applied to phase-1-boot-adversarial per Review-B) extended to phase-w3-video-auth.
